title: The lighted tower doesn't shine brightly for more than 2 minutes!!!
text:
The lighted tower doesn't shine brightly for more than 2 minutes!!!. I would have given this product 5 stars if it wasn't for the below listed items:

1. When I purchased this item, it was advertised to come with the space needle statue AND a magnet of Seattle. I never received the magnet. I emailed the Seller and no response was received.

2. The light on the space needle shines vividly for about two minutes then it dulls to where you can hardly see it, even in the dark. I have to turn it off, wait a few hours, then turn it back on to get the brightly lit tower for another two minutes. I put fresh cells (batteries) in it and got the same results. I don't know whether it's defective or the way it's manufactured. Either way, I've received no response for the Seller to my email. If defective, I'd like a replacement.
